fields.name: title
fields.documentation: Award/grant title (openMINDS Funding.awardTitle); the award number / grant DOI rides on global_identifier{scheme='AwardNumber'} (openMINDS Funding.awardNumber). Its funder is a `directed_relation` -> organization (openMINDS Funding.funder).

fields.name: local_identifier
fields.documentation: Optional human-facing handle for this entity, used to cross-reference it within its dataset (distinct from any display name/title). Required on subject; optional here.
